ja: ごめんなさい、今週はとても忙しいので、プレゼン資料作りは手伝えないんです。
en: Sorry, I can't help you with the slides because I'm really busy this week.
alternatives: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy this week to help with the slides.
Sorry, I'm really busy this week, so I can't help with the presentation slides.
point: 「〜を手伝う」は help you with the slides の語順

ja: この件は、経理に詳しい田中さんに頼んだほうがいいですよ。
en: You should ask Tanaka, who knows a lot about accounting, to handle this.
alternatives: It'd be best to ask Tanaka, who knows a lot about accounting, to handle this.
You should leave this to Tanaka, who knows a lot about accounting.
point: 人に説明を足すときはカンマ＋who で補足する

ja: あなたがもっと早く頼んでくれていたら、私は金曜までに仕上げられたのに。
en: If you had asked me sooner, I could have finished it by Friday.
alternatives: If you'd asked me earlier, I could've gotten it done by Friday.
If you'd come to me sooner, I would have been able to finish it by Friday.
point: 過去の事実に反する仮定は had asked と could have finished

ja: この翻訳、もっと早くお願いしておけばよかったです。締め切りは明日なんです。
en: I wish I had asked you to translate this sooner. The deadline is tomorrow.
alternatives: I wish I'd asked you to translate this earlier. The deadline is tomorrow.
I should have asked you to translate this sooner. The deadline is tomorrow.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish のあとを過去完了に

ja: 予算の条件を確認したうえで、私たちはその案件を来月から引き受けることにしました。
en: Having checked the budget, we decided to take on the project starting next month.
alternatives: Having confirmed the budget terms, we decided to take on the project from next month.
After going over the budget, we decided to take the project on starting next month.
point: 先に済ませた動作は Having checked で表す

ja: 私たちが本当に必要としているのは、金曜までにこのデータを確認してくれる人です。
en: What we really need is someone who can check this data by Friday.
alternatives: What we really need is someone to check this data by Friday.
The thing we really need is someone who can check this data by Friday.
point: 「〜なのは」は What で始めて is でつなぐ

ja: 翻訳をお願いしたくて、私は朝からずっと佐藤さんに電話しているんです。
en: I've been calling Mr. Sato all morning to ask for a translation.
alternatives: I've been calling Ms. Sato all morning to ask for a translation.
I've been trying to reach Mr. Sato since this morning to ask for a translation.
point: 朝から続けている動作は I've been calling

ja: 彼女はその依頼を引き受けてくれただけでなく、週末も手伝うと申し出てくれました。
en: Not only did she take on the job, but she also offered to help over the weekend.
alternatives: She not only agreed to the request but also offered to help over the weekend.
Not only did she accept the request, but she also offered to help on the weekend.
point: Not only を文頭に置くと did she の語順になる

ja: そのデータ入力の作業は、来週外部の会社に任されることになっています。
en: The data entry work will be handed over to an outside company next week.
alternatives: The data entry work is going to be outsourced to another company next week.
Next week, the data entry work will be given to an outside company.
point: 作業が「任される」側なので will be + 過去分詞の受動態

ja: もし彼があの時その依頼を断っていたら、今ごろこんなに忙しくはなかったでしょうね。
en: If he had turned down that request back then, he wouldn't be this busy now.
alternatives: If he'd said no to that request back then, he wouldn't be so busy now.
If he'd declined that request back then, he wouldn't be this busy right now.
point: if 節は過去完了、主節は今の話なので wouldn't be
